# Verxio

> Verxio is an AI coworker platform that automates workflows and deploys intelligent agents to Slack, Discord, Telegram, and WhatsApp.

## About Verxio

Verxio is a SaaS platform designed for teams, marketers, agencies, and founders who want AI agents that do real work. Instead of building bots from scratch or stitching together dozens of tools, users describe what they need and Verxio creates, deploys, and manages AI-powered agents that operate across chat channels and automate multi-step workflows.

Verxio is not a chatbot builder. It is a full AI coworker platform where agents have persistent skills, domain knowledge, custom personalities, and access to 10,000+ actions across 800+ apps.

## Core Capabilities

### AI Agents in Chat Channels
Verxio agents deploy directly into Slack, Discord, Telegram, and WhatsApp workspaces. They join as team members, respond to mentions and direct messages, execute tasks, and report results. Each agent can be given a unique personality (soul.md), skills, and workflows. Agents can evolve their personality over time based on interactions.

### Visual Workflow Builder
A drag-and-drop canvas where users connect triggers, actions, conditions, AI model calls, and integrations into automated workflows. Nodes include webhook triggers, timed triggers, code blocks, AI model nodes (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini), and integration nodes for 800+ apps. Workflows execute automatically when triggered.

### Custom Skills and Knowledge
Each agent can be taught domain-specific knowledge through custom skills. Users upload documents, define procedures, and add tool integrations. Skills are scoped per agent or shared across agents. This allows agents to become experts in specific domains like customer support, sales qualification, content creation, or DevOps monitoring.

### 10,000+ Integrations
Powered by Composio, Verxio connects to Gmail, Slack, Discord, GitHub, Notion, Jira, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Stripe, Airtable, Linear, Telegram, WhatsApp, and 800+ more apps. Each integration provides multiple actions and triggers.

### Multi-Model AI Support
Workflows support multiple AI providers including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, and Google Gemini. Users can use their own API keys or rely on Verxio's built-in credits. Different nodes in the same workflow can use different models.

### Video and Image Generation
Verxio includes nodes for AI video generation (Google Veo, Kling AI with text-to-video, image-to-video, video extend, motion control, and omni modes), AI image generation (Kling AI, SeedReam), and text-to-speech. These integrate directly into workflows alongside other actions.

## How It Works

1. Connect a channel: Link Slack, Discord, Telegram, or WhatsApp. The agent joins as a team member.
2. Define what it does: Set a personality, choose workflows, add skills. Give it access to your tools and knowledge.
3. Build and publish: Create workflows and connect your apps. The agent helps you automate and integrate.
4. Deploy and automate: The agent goes live instantly. It handles tasks, runs workflows, and collaborates with your team around the clock.

## Use Cases

### Marketing Teams
- Deploy a marketing bot that handles social scheduling, email sequences, and analytics reporting
- Build landing pages and sales funnels from a text description
- Create and manage a company blog with SEO-optimized posts
- Automate content creation across multiple channels

### Sales Teams
- Build a sales assistant that qualifies leads, schedules demos, and updates the CRM
- Create high-converting sales funnels with checkout, upsell, and downsell pages
- Automate follow-up sequences and lead nurturing workflows

### Customer Support
- Deploy support agents that handle ticket triage, FAQ responses, and escalations
- Integrate with help desk tools, CRMs, and communication channels
- Provide 24/7 automated support with human escalation paths

### DevOps and Engineering
- Monitor deployments, run health checks, and alert teams on incidents
- Automate CI/CD notifications and status updates
- Connect to GitHub, Jira, Linear, and other development tools

### Content and Media
- Generate blog drafts, social posts, and newsletters automatically
- Create AI-generated videos and images as part of content workflows
- Manage multi-channel content distribution

### Agencies
- White-label the platform for client deployments
- Manage multiple client workspaces from a single account
- Build and deliver websites, funnels, and automation workflows for clients

## Technical Architecture

- Frontend: Next.js (React) with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components
- Backend: Express.js with TypeScript, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL
- AI: Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI, Google Gemini
- Workflow engine: Inngest for durable, event-driven workflow execution
- Integrations: Composio for 800+ app connections
- Chat: Direct API integrations with Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Verxio?
Verxio is an AI coworker platform. It lets you spin up AI agents that automate workflows and work inside Slack, Discord, Telegram, and WhatsApp as team members.

### Is Verxio a chatbot builder?
No. Verxio is a full AI agent platform. Agents have persistent skills, workflows, domain knowledge, custom personalities, and access to 10,000+ actions across 800+ apps. They do real work, not just answer questions.

### What can Verxio agents do?
Agents can automate workflows, run multi-step tasks, connect to 800+ apps, and execute actions in Slack, Discord, Telegram, and WhatsApp. They use AI for planning, code generation, and decision-making inside workflows.

### What chat platforms does Verxio support?
Slack, Discord, Telegram, and WhatsApp. Agents join as team members and respond to mentions and messages.

### Can I use my own AI API keys?
Yes. You can bring your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or other API keys and use them in workflows alongside Verxio's built-in credits.

### How many integrations does Verxio have?
Over 10,000 actions across 800+ apps including Gmail, Slack, Discord, GitHub, Notion, Jira, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Stripe, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Airtable, Linear, and many more.
